summary: Lookout post from 1922, when forest guard Mr. Wade watched for fires; a secondary lookout by 1927. No source describes the site today.

events.note: Forest guard Mr. Wade stationed atop the mountain as a lookout for fires.
Used as a secondary lookout and equipped with an alidade; other improvements not known.

notes_for_editor: Two dated entries (1922, 1927) from one source, Kemnow's page, which gives no first name for Mr. Wade and no structure details. The Forest Service page does not name Estes Mountain among surviving lookouts; its list of remaining lookouts is not exhaustive. Estes Mountain is absent from the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/id/), the Idaho Fire Lookouts index was not searched for it, and the NHLR Idaho index has no entry. The record's 'Challis National Forest' is the name the source uses; the story does not explain the later forest name. Status and access remain unknown, so no facts beyond the agency are recorded. The story's gloss of 'alidade' as a sighting instrument is general knowledge; the page does not define the term.
